## Goal

`record.policy` (local | remote, default local) as a team key; under remote every step boundary pushes the story's record, packed into one commit, to `refs/norn/runs/<story>` after the branch, retried at the next tick when it fails (B9–B12, B14, B34; D2–D4).

## Progress

- Config: `record.policy` in RepoConfig / ResolvedConfig (`packages/schema/src/config.ts`), team key, config get/set and doctor via the existing config checks; schema:emit and docs:emit rerun.
- Ref name: `recordRef(story)` in `packages/schema/src/ids.ts` (`refs/norn/runs/<story>`).
- Store `packages/store/src/record-ref.ts`: `pushRecord` (hash-object, temp index, write-tree, commit-tree; parent = last seen sha; trailers Norn-Story / Norn-Branch-Commit / Norn-Holder; commit time = tick time; CAS push with lease), `unpackRecord` (temp folder, recordErrors per unit folder, atomic rename), `recordTreeId` (git tree id computed in JS from the files, so observe writes nothing, H2), `readRecordRef`.
- Observe: under remote, on the holder, `StoryFacts.record = { tree, pushed }`. Decide: `push_record` (rule `record.push`) when the tree differs from the pushed one, or a `move_record` of the story lands this tick (D13 step 4). It is a side action (`isTailAction`) act performs after every other action, so after the branch push. A failed push is not recorded as a unit act failure: the next tick sees the tree still differs and retries (B14).
- Tests: `packages/cli/test/integration/record-ref.test.ts` (AC1–AC7 plus unpack through a clone); rule case for `record.push` in `packages/core/test/rule-cases.ts`. `golden --update`: 0 of 121 cases changed (golden configs have no record key → local).
- Decision: decide reads `config.record?.policy ?? "local"` because older traces' configs (golden, `run view --why`) carry no `record`; `legacyConfig` is left alone so traces still round-trip byte for byte.
- `bun run golden`: kept the two harvested `record-ref-*` cases (receipts.apply, record.push); dropped three unrelated harvests (check-run, housekeeping, agent-protocol) to stay in scope. Transcripts and observe snapshots: no diff (default policy local). The e2e init test now expects `record` in the team schema's keys.
- Tiers: unit 1211 pass / 0 fail; integration 739 pass, 6 skip, 0 fail; e2e 71 pass, 2 skip, 0 fail (the skips were there before this slice). No flakes.
- Rework review#1 (implement #2): F1 `hash-object --no-filters` (a seeded property check against real git under core.autocrlf=input and a clean filter, plus a harness test that a CRLF file is packed as is and the next tick pushes nothing); F2 unpack refuses non-plain entries and paths outside the record before writing anything, reading `ls-tree -z` from the first tab; F3 unpack renames the validated folder into place, replacing the old one; F5 the record waits while the story branch is not on the remote as it is locally, and the lookup no longer swallows errors; F6 every JSON file must parse (state, workflow, receipts also pass their schema), symlinks are refused; F7 dot-named staging and temp entries are not packed; F8 a story run with no record key pushes no ref; F4 left to slices 10–12, but the trace now says why a stale or rejected push failed. Tests: `packages/store/test/integration/record-ref.test.ts`, plus new cases in the cli record-ref test.
- Known limit (later slices): a holder whose lease went stale (another checkout pushed the ref) retries every tick and fails until a takeover/fetch slice settles it.
- implement#1 done: record.policy (local|remote, default local) team key; store pack/push (lease, parent chain, trailers) and validated unpack in record-ref.ts; observe reports record tree vs last pushed ref under remote; decide push_record (record.push) as a tail side action after branch pushes; failed push retried next tick. AC1-AC7 in packages/cli/test/integration/record-ref.test.ts; all tiers green.

Blocking: F1 `record-ref.ts:90` hash-object without `--no-filters`: under `core.autocrlf=input` (this machine's global config) the packed tree differs from `recordTreeId` and from the files on disk, so push_record is decided every tick. The property check against real git: 55/60 random trees mismatched with CRLF content, 0/60 without it. Modes (both always 100644), nested dirs, dir-vs-file ordering, empty dirs, symlinks (both skip them) and non-ASCII names all match. F2 `record-ref.ts:148` unpack trusts tree paths (`git mktree` accepts `..`). F3 `record-ref.ts:163` unpack merges into an existing dest instead of replacing it (D3). Minor: F4 a stale lease fails every tick with nothing surfaced (for 10-12); F5 the record is pushed even when the branch push failed; F6 "every JSON" wording, symlinks. Nits: F7 staging folders get packed; F8 AC1's "absent" is not run through a story.

The review#1 points are resolved. I checked each one again on the new code:
- tree-prop: 60 random trees under global `core.autocrlf=input` plus a `* filter=upper` clean filter, with CRLF, tabs, exec bits, symlinks, empty dirs and non-ASCII names; 0 of 60 mismatch. I confirmed the filter was active for a plain hash-object.
- Hostile records against unpackRecord: `..`, `.`, a nested `..`, a symlink and a gitlink are each refused, with nothing written and nothing escaping. Tab and newline names unpack whole. A 100755 entry unpacks. Unpacking over an existing folder replaces it.
